messages:
ari: quick heads-up — I'm kicking off the shim rollout for router->runtime header split during the 02:00 UTC change window. planning to pin runtime to v2.3.1 and router to r5b.
ari: noticed eviction TTLs differ between staging and prod: staging has kv.eviction: 60s, prod 120s. worried about increased cold-starts for the shim.
sam: holding on the canary until we reconcile eviction TTLs. console contract depends on transient cache assumptions (mia flagged this yesterday). :eyes:
ari: yes — canary paused. can someone confirm which service owns the eviction config?
mia: cache-service owns default TTL. I can flip prod -> 60s but need a short maintenance window. is 02:15 UTC okay?
jordan: 02:15 sounds fine from infra side. but runtime autoscaler warms slower with 60s — we might see a bit more burst latency for first few minutes. recommend keeping canary low qps (10rps) for first 10m.
ari: good call. deploy-bot: preflight report?
deploy-bot: preflight results for thread 1728459999:
- runtime v2.3.1: smoke ✅
- router r5b: smoke ✅
- console schema match: WARN (optional header 'x-rw-shim' not present in prod examples)
- evictions mismatch: FAIL (prod 120s != expected 60s)
see /deploy/reports/1728459999
sam: we need console to accept missing header gracefully or prove no customers rely on it. mia, can you run a quick schema-compat check against prod traces?
mia: running now. grabbing traces from last 24h.
mia: quick grep shows ~0.3% requests include x-rw-shim header in prod (internal backfills only). seems safe to make header optional.
jordan: ops note — if we change prod TTL to 60s, eviction churn may spike; I'll pre-warm some runtime nodes 10m before the window.
ari: plan update: pause canary -> reconcile TTL -> small TTL flip at 02:15 -> pre-warm runtime -> resume canary at 02:30 at 10rps for 10m -> increase to 50rps if stable -> monitor P95 latency and error rate. rollback criteria below.
sam: add release notes: list the header as optional and mention TTL change. also include rollback playbook.
ari: rollback criteria (agreed):
- P95 text-gen latency increases > 200ms above baseline for 3 consecutive 1m windows, OR
- error rate (5xx) > 0.5% for 5 minutes, OR
- router KV misses increase > 50% vs baseline for 5m.
ari: rollback steps:
1) immediate unpin: route traffic back to runtime v2.2.9 and router r5a via feature-flag playbook.
2) revert TTL to 120s in cache-service if eviction churn harmful.
3) open incident and notify #eng-oncall + #support.
4) capture traces and PID dumps.
mia: I'll update the console contract to make header optional and push a tiny canary to console at 01:45 to validate.
jordan: I'll schedule pre-warm at 02:05 and keep 30m of extra capacity pinned until 03:00.
deploy-bot: scheduling: canary job created (id: cb-1728459999). canary start: 02:30 UTC, initial qps: 10, duration: 10m. pre-canary checks at 02:20.
sam: thanks — I'll draft the release note blurb and add the rollback steps. ping me once console canary is green. :thumbsup:
ari: update 02:18 UTC: console canary green, header optional verified, no regressions.
jordan: pre-warm done at 02:10. nodes report healthy.
ari: resuming canary at 02:30 per deploy-bot. monitoring dashboards linked: https://console.internal/r/1728459999/dash
ari: quick status after 5m: P95 +30ms, errors unchanged. continuing.
sam: after 10m, stepping to 50rps.
ari: 02:45 status: P95 +25ms, errors 0.12%, KV misses +8%. all within thresholds. moving to full rollout over next 15m.
deploy-bot: rollout staged: 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m. next stage at 03:00.
mia: observed one customer trace hitting missing header path but handled gracefully. logging increased as expected.
jordan: eviction churn peaked at 02:18 then normalized. metrics look fine.
ari: final: rollout complete at 03:12 UTC. marking thread resolved. will follow up with release note and postmortem if anything pops. :tada:
sam: nice work team. saving config diff to /configs/cache-service/eviction/1728459999.diff
deploy-bot: thread closed (cb-1728459999)
